purpose: Let the user inspect the existing original-contract workflow and synthetic scenarios immediately.

checks.name: Standalone preview route serves the IFPMIC page offline
workflow cards, phases, edges and terminal match the V1 display contract
selecting a node exposes its public detail fields and requirement links
search, owner filtering, result counts and clear operate on the displayed graph
special outcomes and business failure route controls navigate to their target nodes
workflow cards support ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Home and End while skipping filtered nodes
desktop and 375px mobile layouts expose core details without page overflow
read-only visualizer sends no API/write requests or external network traffic
design view is the default and replay view requires explicit selection
catalog exposes all 74 scenarios and starts each at cursor zero
all 74 scenarios reach their fixed endpoint through the end-observation control
all controls checkpoints expose literal control state and three read-only semantic groups
approved controls checkpoints are captured in three semantic groups at 375px and 1440px
routing scenarios expose reuse, exemption, terminal, candidate and replan authority checkpoints
scenario change clears display filters and resets selection and cursor
previous/next/first/last and checkpoint selection move stored prefixes only
observation panel separates mock job, step, agent and gate data and opens current node
metadata recovery and notes checkpoints keep current approval and publication observability
retry, cycle and device telemetry are distinct and never expose allocatable authority
current-stage navigation reveals, focuses and scrolls a node hidden by active filters
question panels distinguish durable answer, current-attempt review and archived review history
remote panel shows stale-query rejection, one found receipt and quarantine independently
SQE manual, report and judgment checkpoints remain separate across retries and history
child coordinator and TC execution remain separate, bound, and legible across all nine fixed checkpoints
question review-blocked checkpoint remains legible at 1440px and 375px
1440px and 375px layouts expose replay controls and details without horizontal page overflow
browser replay makes no API writes, external requests or runtime errors

source_preservation.method: Static exact B01 manifest/hash/inventory and original source-manifest comparison; all matched.
source_preservation.scope: Source preservation only; no complete Node/API/Paperclip regression claim.

delivery_scope: ExistingUI served on loopback; no protected product source change
not_completed: Full H2 and B03 or H3-H7 acceptance
next_visible_increment: Register one real request and show its persisted job/current stage/wait reason through the authorized API, with ownership and duplicate/error checks.
